name: Booze & Bachata Featuring Nicole from ATL !
location: Faces Brewing Co.
description:
On Sunday, May 31st, from 4-8 PM we're hosting a social to re-connect with the dance community and bring in one of our favorite industry professionals to Boston - Nicole. 



ABOUT NICOLE:

Nicole is the definition of a talented, committed, and genuine dancer in the scene. Just like us, she is cross trained and loves all styles of bachata, prioritizes the importance of training and strong technique, is an advocate for the dance community and makes the industry a better place through her company Society Dance. Oh - and she's truly one of the kindest people and we love her as a human - like all of our artists we bring out!




WHERE: 

At Booze and Bachata we focus on offering intimate, high level social dance events and education located at local craft beverage establishments where we play ALL STYLES of bachata. This event will be held at Faces Brewing Co. at 50 Pleasant Street, Malden MA 02148. They make their own craft beer and offer a variety of beverages along with all kinds of curated food including tacos, pizzas, and much more! Check out their food and bev here: https://www.facesbrewing.com/menu/




THE DETAILS: 

For this event we have an open level, bachata fusion partner work class at 4 PM with Nicole and Luis, followed by social dancing and time to connect with the community. Social dancing goes from 5-8 PM, the kitchen stays open until 8:45 PM, last call at the bar is at 9:15 PM, and the establishment closes at 10 PM (plenty of time to dance and connect).

name: Singles salsa night at Juliet / Dance class + cocktail mixer
location: Juliet, 263 Washington St, Somerville, MA  02143, United States
description:
Join us at Juliet for a relaxed, social night designed for meeting new people—no experience required.
 
We’ll start with a cocktail hour mixer—complimentary light bites, a drink in hand, and time to connect before the music starts. Then, a beginner-friendly salsa class where you’ll learn the basics in a fun, low-pressure environment (no partner needed).
 
After class, stick around as the room opens up into a casual social dance—practice what you’ve learned, switch partners, and let the night unfold naturally.
 
Whether you come for the dancing, the conversation, or just something different—this is a night built to be easy, warm, and a little bit electric.
 
Class is taught by Josh, who will be freshly returned from Cali, Colombia, Salsa capital of the world. We will have some experienced dancers, both leaders and followers, at the social dance, to keep things fresh, and help you practice what you have just learned in class.

location: 620 Massachusetts Ave, Cambridge, MA 02139-3368, United States
description:
🔥 ROOTS & CONNECTION: Konpa x Kizomba🔥
A 7-Week Progressive Training Series

You’ve been asking us to bring classes closer to the city… so we’re making it happen 👀🔥

This summer, we’re bringing the EJ Dance Studio experience straight to the dance hub of Central Square in Cambridge for a special 7-week Konpa x Kizomba training series focused on what truly makes social dancing feel GOOD: connection, flow, musicality, and movement.

What if improving your Kizomba wasn’t about learning more “moves”… but about improving the way you connect, lead, follow, transition, and feel the music? 🎶

Welcome to Roots & Connection — a guided training experience where each week builds on the last, using Konpa foundations to elevate your Kizomba and overall partner dancing.

Whether you dance Kizomba, Urban Kiz, Konpa, or simply want to become a smoother, more confident social dancer, this series is designed to help you:
✨ Build deeper connection
✨ Develop smoother flow & cleaner transitions
✨ Improve musicality & movement quality
✨ Strengthen partnering skills
✨ Gain confidence on the social dance floor

💃🏽 No partner required

Get ready to move to the infectious rhythms of Bachata, a dance from the Dominican Republic! This class is all about having fun and moving your body. The class will focus on high-energy follow-alongs that get your heart pumping with bachata footwork. If there is interest towards the end of the class,  we'll learn some fundamental partner work moves and get to connect with classmates.
The focus is on joy, not perfection! Liz's goal is for you to feel energized, move your body, and get a taste of social dancing.
This class is designed for EVERYBODY and EVERY BODY. We enthusiastically welcome students of all abilities, and can provide physical modifications and adaptations to ensure everyone can fully participate and enjoy the movement. No prior dance experiences is needed, and you do not need to bring a partner.

Get ready to move to the infectious rhythms of Bachata, a dance from the Dominican Republic! This class is all about having fun and moving your body.
